Messages.Author: Rafid Armani
Messages.Body:
If I have Anson, a Rumors of Gehenna and a Parthenon in play,
how many master phase action have I, and why ?
How many master cards can I play and why ?
How many master out-of-turn can I play ?

Can I play multiple Brainwash on the same uncontrolled
vampire (it's not unique) ?

If I bleed with a Social Charm in superior and the bleed
is deflected but not blocked by it's new target, does it means
that I take a blood because the bleed is successful but I don't
take the edge because I didn't bled my prey ?

If I use a Forced Awakening to play a reaction card,
does my vampire pay a blood for not blocking (he didn't
attempt to block) ?

Thank you very much for your time,

Rafid Armani,
ra...@mediom.qc.ca
www.mediom.qc.ca/~rafid/

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 25 Jun 2000, Rafid Armani wrote:

> If I have Anson, a Rumors of Gehenna and a Parthenon in play,
> how many master phase action have I, and why ?

3.

Anson sets your base number to 2 (from whatever it is currently i.e. 1)
Rumors sets your base number to 2 (from whatever it is currently, i.e. 2)
The Parthenon allows you to add 1. (2 + 1)

> How many master cards can I play and why ?

3. Number as above, and you can trade each one in for a mastear card.

> How many master out-of-turn can I play ?

1 between turns. You can only ever play 1 between turns, regardless of
how many master phase actions you can generate.

It counts against the first one. So, you could then play 2 master cards
during your next turn.

> Can I play multiple Brainwash on the same uncontrolled
> vampire (it's not unique) ?

Yes. Or you can play it on multiple other vampires/

> If I bleed with a Social Charm in superior and the bleed
> is deflected but not blocked by it's new target, does it means
> that I take a blood because the bleed is successful

Yes.

> but I don't
> take the edge because I didn't bled my prey ?

No, you take the edge anyway. All it cares about, as with you getting the
pool, is that the bleed is successful.

> If I use a Forced Awakening to play a reaction card,
> does my vampire pay a blood for not blocking (he didn't
> attempt to block) ?

He burns a blood, yes. (That is, assuming he doesn't go on to block - if,
say, your reaction card was a Spirit's Touch and you went on to block, you
wouldn't - but if it was a deflection and so you didn't block, you would
burn the blood.)

Generally you get the Edge whenever you successfully bleed _any_
Methusaleh. I've included the relevant sections of the online rulebook
(sections 1.2, and 6.1.1) below.

---

[1.2. Equipment Needed]
3. The Edge: The Edge is a symbol showing that your minions have
temporarily given you an advantage over the other Methuselahs. It is
given or passed to a player who successfully bleeds another player (see
Bleed, sec. 6.1.1),

[6.1.1. Bleed]
To bleed a Methuselah, announce the action and tap the acting minion
(the minion who is taking the bleed action). If the action is
successful, the target Methuselah burns an amount of pool equal to the
bleed amount. By default, all vampires have a bleed amount of one,
while allies have a bleed amount of zero (although many allies and some
vampires have card text that overrides the default). Additionally, if
the action succeeds and the bleed amount is one or more, then the
controller of the acting minion gets the Edge, taking it from whomever
has it (or simply keeping the Edge, if she already has it).
